prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational image edit.
Edit the provided white stone head with pink-purple nerve highlights. Preserve the left-facing near-profile three-quarter pose, prominent near ear, full crown and short neck, square composition, soft studio lighting and genuinely transparent alpha background.

The user wants TWO changes:
A) The current sculpture is too angular. Make the front face, forehead, cheeks, jaw, cranium and neck softly rounded and continuous, like a contemporary hand-carved white marble or limestone bust. Eliminate every polygonal/low-poly facet and hard geometric plane. Keep subtle fine white stone grain and a matte carved finish, blank softly sculpted eyes, restrained simplified facial features. It must remain unmistakably stone, not realistic human skin: no eyelashes, eyebrow hairs, wet eyes, skin coloration or lifelike pores.
B) Make the entire posterior half of the cranium genuinely transparent so the internal highlighted pathway can be clearly seen in full. Replace the narrow triangular slot with a broad transparent rear cranial hemisphere beginning behind the brow/temple and extending over the crown, back of skull and down to the upper neck. The face, front of neck and outer ear remain opaque white carved stone. The back shell is very clear, subtle glass-like transparency, with only a faint edge defining its rounded silhouette. Avoid heavy frost or reflections that obscure the interior. Smoothly blend the stone front into the transparent back without a hard rectangular window.

INTERIOR: Through the transparent rear half, reveal a simplified neutral pale-white/soft-gray brain and descending brainstem as unobtrusive anatomical context. Use reduced opacity and delicate contours so the highlighted parts are fully visible. Keep all cerebral cortex, corpus callosum, cerebellum and other context UNCOLOURED and visually quiet; they are not targets. Do not light up the whole brain.

COLOURED PATHWAY ONLY: Bright restrained pink fine fibres in the outer-ear conchal bowl identify the intended auricular vagus sensory target. A delicate pink-to-violet nerve route travels INWARD/deep from the ear toward the brainstem, not upward into the temporal cortex. Purple highlights are limited to two small anatomically informed schematic downstream relay areas: nucleus tractus solitarius in dorsal medulla (lower brainstem) and locus coeruleus in dorsal upper pons, connected subtly. The lower relay and upper relay should be separately readable through the transparent back. They represent a PROPOSED sensory-signalling pathway and downstream regions of interest, not direct electrical stimulation sites or measured activity. No highlighted cortical 'focus centre', no central glowing brain ball, no spurious coloured networks, no extra nerves across face or neck. No gold/orange/blue/green.
Keep pink and purple contained within the intended pathway and small relay highlights, crisp and saturated enough to remain clear at website size with minimal bloom. This is an elegant simplified scientific art concept, not an exhaustive anatomical atlas.

Overall finish: premium modern smooth white-stone sculpture with a clear transparent rear cranium and a legible pink-purple pathway inside. No angularity, no hyperreal skin, no dissection gore. No labels, text, arrows, numbers, logos, watermark, plinth, earbuds, floor or backdrop. Retain true background transparency, complete uncropped silhouette and comfortable margins. High-resolution polished 3D product-render quality.
